name: Hairball v0.1.1 (test build)
body: Test build, not tuned by ear yet. Free and open source (Hairball). One zip: installers for Windows (.exe), macOS (.pkg), Linux (Flatpak extensions and a plain .vst3), the PDF manual and INSTALL.txt. Everything works offline. SHA-256 sums are inside the zip.
